todos.description: Implement predict_tc function in scripts/predict_tc.py using the McMillan-Allen-Dynes equation, loading lambda, omega_log, mu_star from data/superconductor_database.json.
Populate data/superconductor_database.json with verified entries for known superconductors (H3S, LaH10, YH9, MgB2, YBCO) including lambda, omega_log, mu_star, and reference Tc.
Delete duplicate test file tests/tests_predict_tc.py that duplicates tests/tests_predict_tc.py content.

Consolidate duplicate documents: remove root copies of candidate_materials.md, characterization_techniques.md, literature_review.md, roadmap.md, synthesis_methods.md, theoretical_framework.md; move discovery_strategy.md from root to docs/; update README.md links to point to docs/ versions and fix broken link to discovery_strategy.md.

Also (council-synthesis): Add sections on electron-phonon coupling, DMFT, and spin fluctuations to theoretical_framework.md.
Add detailed synthesis protocols for YH10, CaH12, MgH16 to proposed_chemistry_physics.md, or cross-reference docs/experimental_protocol_hydride.md if it exists.
Update docs/online_research_summary.md with findings from at least 5 recent papers (2020+) on hydrides, nickelates, and carbon-based systems.
